665b72f6a3a0fae7efc0:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Sales'[Region],
			"AverageQty", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Sales'[Qty])),
			"VariancePrice", CALCULATE(VAR.P('Sales'[Price]))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Sales'[Region], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Sales'[Region]
